meaning:
ἀποτόμως
adv., [in LXX: Wis.5:22 * ;]
abruptly, curtly, hence sharply, severely: 2Co.13:10, Tit.1:13 (MM, see word).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up…
This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,
